Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor basic logs, archive, restore and search jobs

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Logs public preview capabilities are now available in four new Azure regions: US Virgina Gov, US Arizona Gov, China East 3, and China North 3.

The public preview features are:

  1. Basic logs plan: Log Analytics workspace overview - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Docs
  2. Archive: Configure data retention and archive in Azure Monitor Logs (Preview) - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Docs
  3. Search jobs: Search jobs in Azure Monitor (Preview) - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Docs
  4. Restore: Restore logs in Azure Monitor (Preview) - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Docs
